actions.title: Free Talk
actions.subtitle: 5-minute conversation
actions.prompt: Start a 5-minute English free-talk session. Pick a light topic, correct only important mistakes, and end with 3 phrases I should reuse.

actions.title: Correct Me
actions.subtitle: Polish what I just said
actions.prompt: I will write or dictate English. Correct grammar and naturalness, show a better version, and explain briefly.

actions.title: Daily Drill
actions.subtitle: Schedule practice
actions.prompt: Design a short daily English drill for me and offer to create an iOS Reminder so I practice on schedule.
